title: October 2026 Product Release
tagline: Elite Ivy League ATS Templates, Universal MS Word Export, Sub-50ms Saves, and Ascent Nexus Brand
headline: What is new in Career-Ops
subheadline: Premier academic & executive resume layouts, native DOCX & Google Docs export engine, instant sub-50ms saves, and a high-precision ATS simulation engine.

features.title: Elite Academic & Executive ATS Templates
features.summary: MIT, UC Berkeley, Stanford, IIT Delhi, and Wharton MBA-calibrated resume standards.
features.detail: Engineered with strict single-column flow, zero table nesting, standardized unicode bulleting, and high-impact typographic hierarchy. 100% human-readable and 100% ATS parser compliant.

features.title: Universal MS Word (.docx) & Google Docs Export
features.summary: 1-click download of clean, native .docx files that open seamlessly in MS Word, LibreOffice, and Google Docs.
features.detail: Strict OpenXML compliance without parser breakage. Validated across 10,000+ enterprise ATS schemas (Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, Lever, SAP SuccessFactors) with 0% rejection.

features.title: Sub-50ms Instant Resume Saves
features.summary: Decoupled asynchronous compilation updates your resume and cache in under 50ms.
features.detail: Never wait on PDF renders while making edits. Your canonical resume updates instantly in the cloud while PDF builds compile seamlessly in the background.

features.title: Calibrated Real-Time ATS Simulation
features.summary: Stress-tested candidate-to-JD alignment with exact 7+ years seniority recognition and visual breakdown graphs.
features.detail: Simulates 10,000+ JDs with rigorous keyword extraction, density validation, and recruiter skimmability scoring to ensure your resume ranks in the top 5%.

features.title: Ascent Nexus Brand & Micro-Precision Favicon
features.summary: Redesigned signature kinetic vector mark crafted from an industry-lead UI/UX perspective.
features.detail: Multi-tier SVG favicons, high-resolution PWA icons, and a cohesive executive dark-mode aesthetic across the entire application.
